update_schedule: First observed eligible signal of each Gregorian calendar year
training_cutoff: Strictly before the signal date; same-day and later outcomes excluded
criterion: Training CAGR percentage points minus absolute training daily drawdown percentage points
accounting: Continuous portfolio replay; switching is charged through actual target changes, never concatenate independent candidate NAV curves
registration_context: Designed after seeing previous experiments. Chronological decision rules are checked, but this is not untouched out-of-sample evidence.
scope: 76-point general-company subset, current-identity historical universe, no industry or full dividends; no live weight change or promotion
